prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Bhairava, revered powerful manifestation of Shiva in Shaiva and Vajrayana traditions.
ANATOMY: ONE dignified fierce male deity, one head, TWO eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs, fully clothed in heavy opaque dark saffron robes with unmarked antique gold trim [bhairava-c01,bhairava-c02]. RIGHT hand carries large plain punishment ROD [bhairava-c03]; LEFT hand holds a clean ancient skull, no flesh, blood or gore, recalling skull carried to Kashi [bhairava-c06]. ONE dog with one head and four legs serves as his vehicle [bhairava-c04]. No added arms, third eye, fangs, horns, trident or skull garland.
MOMENT: Advance toward viewer astride powerful dog vehicle, lean forward and raise heavy rod in solemn command, eyes severe and focused, robes sweeping; dog forepaws step onto worn stone; deity dominates rather than dog portrait.
POWER: Powerful Shiva manifestation who punishes wrongdoing [bhairava-c02,bhairava-c03]; physical rod and commanding movement only, no invented fire or glowing aura.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; tight close camera, subject fills square, no undocumented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant amber lamp or low moon, deep walnut shadows, hard rim light; ordinary physical dust or wind.
SURFACE: tactile weathered skin, coarse cloth, matted fur, wood and stone; premium painterly brushwork, no plastic.
SETTING: Uninscribed stone approach to Kashi [bhairava-c06].
MOOD: imposing and active; never cute, calm or decorative. Preserve helpful beings as helpful and worshipped deities as dignified and reverential.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.

aura: Documented form and action dominate through low framing and physical light; no aura.
artistic_choices: Opaque saffron robe/trim and composition editorial; clean symbolic skull without gore. No extra iconography not present in claims.
Majesty through tight low-angle procession and rod silhouette; reverential rather than demonic.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: revered imposing deity with two arms, ordinary two eyes and one head, fully opaque saffron robes; right hand extends punishment rod, left carries clean skull, dog vehicle steps forward. Iconography remains distinct at 200px. No third eye/extra limbs, gore, aura or text; reverential stern procession. All seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + upper-body and skull crops. A reverent, majestic fierce manifestation of Shiva: topknot, rudraksha beads, earrings, fully opaque saffron-and-gold robe. Exactly two arms — a raised rod/danda in the right (Dandapani, c03) and a clean, dry, bloodless human skull/kapala in the left (c06, confirmed gore-free in the crop) — no extra heads or arms. The large black dog is his vahana (Shvashva, c04; shown accompanying him rather than literally ridden, which is iconographically correct). Kashi ghats, temple shikhara, lamps and the river behind (c06). Commanding low-angle awe appropriate to a living tradition; no borrowed film design, no generic aura or text.
